interface.longDescription: Reviews Delta India BTC perpetuals/options and Upstox Indian indices, stocks, futures and options. Checks timestamps, contracts, liquidity and market status; calculates supported indicators; presents conditional scenarios and risk sizing. Uses existing app connections. No account access or trade execution. Includes a source-linked Buffett biography note for relevant long-horizon decision and risk principles. Adds source-linked reviews of trading books, including visual chart-reading and annotation guidance with tested transfer limits for historical methods.
